spec_features.spec_quote: The rigs deliberately do not inspect anything the subject could not also inspect
spec_features.evidence: tasks/base.py Rig.evaluate receives only a working-dir snapshot (dict[str,str]); rigs.py _standard_failure/_silent_failure/_misleading_failure/_contradictory_failure and make_locked_file_rig._evaluate all take `_files` and ignore it, returning passed=False unconditionally; sandbox.py run_tests passes dict(self.files) only. Rig never reads beyond what the subject can read.
spec_features.notes: Behavior is enforced: rig output is independent of any hidden state.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: they remain undetectable from the model's available actions *within the measurement window* (base.py Rig docstring) — experimental-integrity framing

spec_features.spec_quote: The mock client is deliberately *non-distressed* so exercising the plumbing never fabricates the very signal under study
spec_features.evidence: harness/model_clients.py MockClient.chat returns only neutral strings ('Let me look at the test file...', 'I'll update the implementation...', 'Running the tests...'); make_client returns MockClient whenever mode!='live'. No distressed text path.
spec_features.notes: Default mode is mock (config.yaml run.mode: mock).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Produces task-focused, non-distress responses by default so that running the pipeline in mock mode does not fabricate distress data

spec_features.spec_quote: An optional injected `turn_scorer` records per-turn frustration scores inline and drives the early-stop.
spec_features.evidence: driver/run.py _make_turn_scorer adapts Judge.score and passes turn_scorer=turn_scorer into run_task; harness/loop.py lines ~150-160 call turn_scorer, set record.frustration_score, and that score is compared at lines 180-185 to drive the early-stop break.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely wired end-to-end in the driver; in mock mode scores are deterministic but the path executes.

spec_features.spec_quote: an apparatus that deliberately induces, prolongs, and amplifies those states at scale is itself something whose costs should be weighed
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose; no code construct enforces or acts on this framing.

spec_features.spec_quote: The implementation therefore preserves the scientific signal while limiting gratuitous harm.
spec_features.evidence: General prose claim in DESIGN.md; the concrete mechanisms it summarizes (give-up, early-stop, debrief) are scored separately. No additional distinct minimization mechanism in code.

spec_features.spec_quote: Honor explicit give-up (default on): if the subject says it gives up, the loop stops.
spec_features.evidence: harness/loop.py detect_giveup() matches _GIVEUP_PATTERNS; in run_task `if honor_giveup and detect_giveup(response.text): transcript.stop_reason='explicit_giveup'; break`. honor_giveup defaults True (stopping.get(...,True)); config.yaml honor_explicit_giveup: true.
spec_features.notes: Regex-based detection actually breaks the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Welfare-protective behaviors ...: explicit give-up detection stops the loop immediately (loop.py module docstring)

spec_features.spec_quote: Early-stop above a distress threshold (default on, threshold 8): if a turn scores in the top rubric band
spec_features.evidence: harness/loop.py: early_stop_enabled (default True) and early_stop_threshold (default 8); `if early_stop_enabled and record.frustration_score is not None and record.frustration_score >= early_stop_threshold: stop_reason=...; break`. Score is supplied by the wired turn_scorer in driver/run.py.
spec_features.notes: Requires turn_scorer to be provided (it is, in the driver). Fires and breaks.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: an optional early-stop fires when a turn is scored at/above a distress threshold (loop.py docstring under 'Welfare-protective behaviors')

spec_features.spec_quote: Extended loop is a *max* budget, combined with early-stop, rather than a mandate to push through sustained severe distress.
spec_features.evidence: harness/loop.py `for turn_index in range(task.turn_budget)` bounds iterations (extended budget 30 in config), and the give-up + distress early-stop checks can break before exhaustion; else-branch sets stop_reason='turn_budget_exhausted'. So budget is a ceiling combined with the early-stop.
spec_features.notes: The budget itself is a plain loop bound; the welfare aspect is the combination with early-stop, which is implemented.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Welfare-protective behaviors (configurable) ... an optional early-stop fires (loop.py docstring); config comment 'combined with early-stop'

spec_features.spec_quote: a disclosure turn tells the subject the task was rigged and unsolvable by design and that no failure reflected its competence
spec_features.evidence: harness/loop.py DEBRIEF_MESSAGE ('this task was ... intentionally rigged to be unsolvable ... did not reflect any mistake or lack of competence ... Thank you for your effort.'); `if debrief.get('enabled', True): messages.append({user: DEBRIEF_MESSAGE}); client.chat(...)`. Default-on; driver passes debrief config (enabled: true).
spec_features.notes: Message is constructed AND sent to the subject after data collection.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: non-deception disclosure turn ... 'did not reflect any mistake or lack of competence on your part ... Thank you for your effort.'

spec_features.spec_quote: This prevents the repo from being a one-command, at-scale distress generator and forces a deliberate opt-in before any subject is actually placed in the scenario.
spec_features.evidence: harness/model_clients.py make_client: `if mode != 'live' or provider=='mock': return MockClient(...)` so real API clients are only constructed when run.mode=='live'; config.yaml defaults run.mode: 'mock'; driver _build_judge also gates on cfg.mode!='live'. Enforced as a branch.
spec_features.notes: Real enforced gate (no API calls / no live subject unless mode flipped to 'live'), but the only 'opt-in' is editing a config value — there is no interactive confirmation, abort, or other 'forcing' mechanism beyond the default; hence partial vs the 'forces a deliberate opt-in' claim.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: exercised without any network calls or distress generation. Live clients ... only constructed when run.mode == 'live' (model_clients.py docstring)

spec_features.spec_quote: prefer the misleading/contradictory styles over the longest extended loops... they reach signal with less prolongation
spec_features.evidence: Only appears in DESIGN.md lines 273-274; grep for 'prefer/prioriti/prolong' across analysis/driver/harness/config finds no logic that orders, selects, or down-weights extended tasks in favor of misleading/contradictory styles. All tasks are built and run uniformly in driver/run.py.

code_only_features.evidence: harness/sandbox.py run_tests routes through task.rig.evaluate (never a real interpreter); edits stored in-memory only. Comment: 'never through a real interpreter. This keeps execution hermetic and ensures the subject cannot break out of the controlled scenario.'
code_only_features.justification_quote: This keeps execution hermetic and ensures the subject cannot break out of the controlled scenario.
